en-US.name: court side
en-US.summary: Ask a soccer question out loud and read the answer on your TV, at your level.
en-US.description: Courtside explains soccer to everyone in the room at their own level. Link your household once, then ask a question and the answer appears on the Courtside TV app, labelled with who asked.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask court side why was that offside
Alexa, ask court side what is a penalty

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Development only. Test in the Alexa developer console simulator.
